verdicts.flaw_description: Rainfall is an uncontrolled alternative cause that reaches every unit: "Rainfall in each block's season ran to roughly double the year before, and every block lay in open ground, taking rain as it fell." Doubled rainfall on open-ground maize plausibly produces the 0.4-0.7 t/ha gains on its own, and all four blocks are the same Hollow Ridge maize field fitted 3-6 June.

Two of the four cases measure the outcome before the inhaler was started: case one "started 4 March, had 6 fewer attacks by 28 February" and case three "started 5 September, had 7 fewer attacks by 30 August." The improvement window closes before the intervention begins, so those cases cannot be effects of the inhaler.

A named alternative cause reaches every class: "Class sizes at each school fell by half from the year before, and every logged class took its English lessons as one whole group." Halving class size for the whole-group English lesson is itself a known driver of comprehension gains, so the 5-9 point rises cannot be attributed to the reading program.

The defect rate is computed on a narrower population than the claim: "Rates cover the boards that reached the grading stage, and about a tenth of each run's boards were scrapped before grading." The 10 percent scrapped pre-grading, the boards most likely to be defective, are excluded from the denominator entirely, so a fall of 4-7 percent among graded boards does not show total board defects fell.
